Backgrounds: B20/B200 uniform draws of training rows (RandomState(2000+j) / (3000+j)); kmeans50: 50 k-means medoids (KMeans(50, n_init=1, random_state=j)
in the model's preprocessing space) weighted by cluster size. Trees: interventional TreeSHAP (exact); weights are realised by repeating each medoid
